groundTruth.rootCause: Product image requests through frontend-proxy are delayed by 10sec; image-provider itself stays fast.
acceptableAlternatives: image requests are delayed before they reach image-provider

hypothesis: Less likely: the frontend-proxy (Envoy) process is overloaded or has a problem of its own. The container is running with no restarts, and the sampled access-log lines show upstream times of only a few ms, so nothing points to Envoy saturation. I had no CPU or memory metrics to rule it out fully.
